mapper.select: /* MainSQL.selectCategoryList */ SELECT CAT_CD AS "catCd", CAT_NM AS "catNm", CAT_LVL AS "catLvl", SORT_SEQ AS "sortSeq" FROM TB_CAT_MNG WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' AND CAT_LVL = 1 ORDER BY SORT_SEQ

/* MainSQL.selectNewPrdList */ SELECT A.PRD_CD AS "prdCd", A.PRD_NM AS "prdNm", A.SMPL_DESC AS "smplDesc", A.PRD_STAT_CD AS "prdStatCd", B.SALE_PRC AS "salePrc", B.CARD_DISC_PRC AS "cardDiscPrc", B.CASH_DISC_PRC AS "cashDiscPrc", C.IMG_PATH AS "imgPath", D.CAT_NM AS "lCatNm" FROM TB_PRD_MST A LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_PRC B ON A.PRD_CD = B.PRD_CD LEFT JOIN TB_PRD_IMG C ON A.PRD_CD = C.PRD_CD AND C.IMG_TP_CD = '10' AND C.SORT_SEQ = 1 LEFT JOIN TB_CAT_MNG D ON A.L_CAT_CD = D.CAT_CD WHERE A.PRD_STAT_CD = '30' ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC LIMIT 8
